brands.name: JCD Surfboards
brands.location_label: Wickham, Newcastle, New South Wales, Australia
brands.short_description: Australian-made custom shortboards, twins, and mid-lengths from Jamie Carr's Newcastle factory.

models.name: BA Twin
models.description: Designed off the Black Apache thruster model with a slightly flattened deck to carry more volume toward the rail while keeping a performance rail. Less width overall with a tight tail for hold on rail; medium single to double concave. More volume than the original Black Apache for the same length, with fins set back for drive and speed.

models.name: Cali
models.description: Old-school style mal with continual rocker and rolled vee bottom for easy turning longboard surfing with directional control from anywhere on the board. Squash tail with concave under the nose; configured for FCS II or Future thruster single box or 2+1 tri-fin setup. Wave size 1–6 ft.

models.name: FG
models.description: Medium to full nose rocker for spicy performance with deep single concave from nose to tail — deepest point just in front of the leading fins for instant speed. Full outline with a mild hip forward of the fins for easy pivot off the single concave. Fast high-performance shortboard for intermediate to advanced surfers.

models.name: Gemini Twin
models.description: A twin with a sleeker outline and foil — a fish twin for speed, tight arc carves, and lip attacks. Exclusively designed as a twin fin but can be surfed with a stabiliser. Spiral vee nose to double concave between the feet and spiral vee exit with contemporary low rails. Ridden 2–3 inches shorter than the BA Twin at the same thickness.

models.name: Mid Six
models.description: Higher nose rocker performance mid-length for power carving turns and hitting lips. Designed as a quad or thruster with six slight channels running from 8 inches in front of the leading fins through the fin cluster. A mid-length design that surfs like a shortboard. Wave size 1–6 ft.

models.name: New Lover
models.description: Based on the all-time favourite Summer Lover — a great board for just about all conditions. Single to flat bottom for more control when it's bigger; wider forward outline for paddle power and instant squirt with a pulled-in thumb tail. Single to double concave mid-range performance model for learner to advanced surfers.

models.name: Slab Hunter
models.description: Originally designed for Ryan Edmond for chasing slabbing waves — forward outline with volume under the chest for easy paddling and wave entry. Medium single to double concave for quick under-the-hood turns and pump through bowls. Also works on long point waves; an all-around step-up from 3 ft to 3× overhead.

models.name: SS3
models.description: Still one of JCD's biggest sellers and a go-to high-performance shortboard. Updated outline with the hip removed around the fins for more drive and a slightly boxier rail from centre to tail. Moderated single and slight double concaves between the fins for a neutral feeling board underfoot.

models.name: Stump
models.description: A very fun fast everyday hybrid performer for all levels. Fuller rail for a no-catch feel with lower entry rocker for instant speed. Medium single with slight double concaves between the fins; full outline with wide tail pod and template for flow and speed over flat spots.

models.name: The Coupë
models.description: High volume performance groveler with single to double to vee for speed, zing, and release. One of JCD's most versatile and popular boards — speed through a ride with vee exit for a responsive fast small-wave grovel machine. Volume and performance crammed into a small-wave go-to. Wave size 1–5 ft.

models.name: Twingle Mid
models.description: A great board for just about all conditions and any ability. Designed as a full single fin for old-school point-style glide, a single with side bites for more drive, or a twin-only option for slide rail turns. Three fin options on one board for a wide variety of waves. Wave size 1–6 ft.

models.name: Wave Slave
models.description: Designed for the JCD team as a small to medium wave competition machine that still holds in solid surf. JCD three-stage rocker with straight single concave throughout for speed and zing; wider tail and pod for planning speed over flats and landing spins. More volume with a performance rail and feel.
